name: Orla
title: the Keywright
examine: Iron filings in the seams of her hands and a loupe on a neck-cord. She files rift-keys by ear — a true cut hums, she says, and a false one only shines. Keeps a ledger of every door she has ever heard.
lines: A key is a song the rock agreed to once. I only remind it.
Worn through is not gone. Nothing your hands have known is gone.
The delvers bring me broken wards to weep over. I charge them for the weeping.
